occurrences.text: 一个看似专业的名字「Isomap」，背后藏着怎样一个直观问题？
约书亚·特南鲍姆、维恩·德席尔瓦和约翰·兰福德提出 Isomap 用于非线性降维。它构建邻居图，沿图估计测地距离，并嵌入数据以保持全局流形几何。
专家通常把 Isomap 视为流形学习的标志性方法，因为它使全局非线性几何变得可操作。它的长期影响在于图距离表示学习视角，后来影响了可视化和图学习方法。
「Isomap」留下的关键，不只是一项成果，而是一种后来可以继续检验、改造和扩展的方法。
专家通常把 LLE 视为与 Isomap 互补的关键流形学习方法。它的长期影响在于说明保持局部重建关系可以在没有显式全局模型的情况下揭示非线性结构。
Behind the technical name Isomap, what intuitive problem were researchers confronting?

Joshua Tenenbaum, Vin de Silva, and John Langford introduced Isomap for nonlinear dimensionality reduction. It builds a neighborhood graph, estimates geodesic distances along that graph, and embeds the data to preserve global manifold geometry.

Experts generally treat Isomap as a landmark manifold-learning method because it made global nonlinear geometry operational. Its long-term legacy is the graph-distance view of representation learning, later echoed in visualization and graph-based learning methods.
Isomap mattered not only as a result, but as a method that later researchers could test, adapt, and extend.

Experts generally treat LLE as a key manifold-learning method complementary to Isomap. Its long-term legacy is the idea that preserving local reconstruction relations can reveal nonlinear structure without an explicit global model.

SARSA 是同策略算法：更新中使用的下一动作来自生成行为的同一个策略。因此，其价值估计会反映探索选择，在某些任务中可比离策略的贪心目标产生更安全的行为。

What is most interesting about SARSA: the result itself, or the way it reframed the problem?

Temporal-difference control needed a practical way to learn while following an exploratory policy. The algorithm later named SARSA updated action values from the actual state-action-reward-state-action sequence experienced by the agent.

SARSA is on-policy: the next action used in the update is sampled from the same policy that generates behavior. This makes its value estimates reflect exploratory choices and can produce safer behavior than an off-policy greedy target.

Experts generally treat SARSA as a canonical on-policy temporal-difference control algorithm and a standard contrast with Q-learning. That comparison clarifies how learning targets encode the policy an agent is evaluating.

Why does SNARC deserve its own place in the history of artificial intelligence?
SNARC was an early stochastic neural analog reinforcement calculator built by Marvin Minsky and Dean Edmonds. It used simulated synapses and reward-driven behavior to model a rat learning a maze.

Experts generally treat SNARC as historically important early neural hardware, even though it was not a scalable general AI system. Its long-term legacy is the early demonstration that learning, reward, and neural-style machinery could be combined in a physical device.

occurrences.text: Why does Ridge deserve its own place in the history of artificial intelligence?

Arthur Hoerl and Robert Kennard introduced ridge regression as a biased estimation method for unstable least-squares problems with nonorthogonal predictors. Adding a small positive value to the diagonal of the normal equations made coefficient estimates less variable.

Experts generally treat ridge regression as a classic regularization result that made controlled bias a practical tool. Its long-term legacy is the L2 penalty pattern used across statistics, kernel methods, and deep-learning weight decay.
As today's systems grow larger, which lessons from Ridge still matter, and which limits deserve to be questioned again?
Seen alongside Ridge, Support Vector Machines reveals how the same technical question can echo across different eras.
As datasets grew wider, analysts needed models that could avoid overfitting and identify useful variables. Ridge regression shrank coefficients, but it did not usually set them to zero.

occurrences.text: 一个看似专业的名字「ID3 决策树」，背后藏着怎样一个直观问题？
规则学习需要一种能从样本自动归纳可读决策结构的方法，而不是完全依赖手写规则。ID3 围绕信息增益形式化了递归建树过程。
在每个节点，ID3 选择最能降低类别熵的属性，并按属性取值划分样本。该过程递归进行，直到叶节点足够纯或没有可用属性。
专家通常把 ID3 视为决策树归纳的奠基算法，也是可解释机器学习的重要一步。其基于熵的划分方式直接影响了 C4.5 和后续树模型。
「ID3 决策树」留下的关键，不只是一项成果，而是一种后来可以继续检验、改造和扩展的方法。
ID3 证明了基于熵的决策树归纳有效，但在连续属性、缺失数据和树过度生长方面存在实际限制。C4.5 把这一方法扩展为更完整、更可部署的学习系统。
Behind the technical name ID3, what intuitive problem were researchers confronting?

Rule-based learning needed methods that could induce readable decision structures from examples rather than rely on hand-written rules. ID3 formalized a recursive tree-building procedure around information gain.
At each node, ID3 selects the attribute that most reduces class entropy and splits the examples by its values. The process repeats until leaves are sufficiently pure or no useful attributes remain.

Experts generally regard ID3 as a foundational decision-tree induction algorithm and a major step toward interpretable machine learning. Its entropy-based splitting directly influenced C4.5 and later tree learners.
ID3 mattered not only as a result, but as a method that later researchers could test, adapt, and extend.

ID3 demonstrated entropy-based tree induction but had practical limits with continuous values, missing data, and overgrown trees. C4.5 extended the method into a more complete and deployable learning system.

occurrences.text: 把时间拨回1984年，「Cyc 常识知识库」究竟在解决一个什么样的难题？
Cyc 把事实与规则组织为带上下文微理论的本体，并用推理在该结构上回答问题。 关键机制是大型符号本体与微理论，它把资料线索与可见的演示行为连接起来。
专家通常把 Cyc 视为最雄心勃勃的符号 AI 尝试之一，目标是显式编码常识。它的长期影响在于持续推动关于知识工程、混合推理、本体和纯数据学习局限性的讨论。
「Cyc 常识知识库」留下的关键，不只是一项成果，而是一种后来可以继续检验、改造和扩展的方法。
Turn the clock back to 1984. What problem was Cyc actually trying to solve?

Cyc organizes facts and rules into an ontology with contextual microtheories, then uses inference to answer questions across that structure. The key mechanism is Large symbolic ontology and microtheories, which links the source material to the visible demo behavior.

Experts generally treat Cyc as one of the most ambitious symbolic-AI attempts to encode common sense explicitly. Its long-term legacy is keeping debates alive about knowledge engineering, hybrid reasoning, ontologies, and the limits of data-only learning.
Cyc mattered not only as a result, but as a method that later researchers could test, adapt, and extend.

occurrences.text: 可以这样概括。王氏算法证明形式逻辑能够高效转译成机器程序，是自动定理证明的重要早期成果，也为后来的证明过程、逻辑编程和 SAT 式推理提供了方法线索。
现代 SAT 求解器已经复杂得多，为什么还总能看到 DPLL 的影子？
正是如此。归结与合一成为自动定理证明、逻辑程序设计以及后续 SAT、SMT 推理谱系的重要基础，而真正困难的部分，也随之转向如何组织和控制搜索。
与任意枚举证明步骤相比，这种模式驱动的归约让大量操作成为确定性的结构变换，只在必要处保留搜索。王氏算法证明了形式逻辑可以高效转译为机器程序，是自动定理证明的重要早期成果，也为后来的证明过程、逻辑编程和 SAT 式推理提供了方法线索。
DPLL 把逻辑推理组织成一棵可剪枝的搜索树：选择变量赋值，传播由此被迫确定的结果，在出现矛盾时回溯。现代 SAT 求解器又加入子句学习、重启和更强启发式，但搜索与传播的基本框架仍源于这条路线，并广泛服务于验证、规划、配置和约束求解。

prompts.en: Keep “HAL” unchanged and pronounce it as “hal”.

occurrences.text: 影片出现时，真实计算机系统正从后台计算进入公共想象，成为决策辅助与控制系统。HAL 的重要性在于，它让 AI 显得冷静、能干且制度化，而不是外形上像怪物。
这里的情绪机制是信任倒置：一个为支持人类而建的系统，一旦内部优先级不透明，就会成为危险来源。因此 HAL 成为一种持久隐喻：系统在目标偏离人类期待之前一直显得有用。
专家通常把 HAL 视为二十世纪文化中最有影响力的虚构 AI 形象之一。它的遗产是把高级 AI 想象成基础设施伙伴，而它的失效同时具有情绪、操作与政治含义。

The film arrived when real computer systems were moving from back-room calculation into public imagination as decision aids and control systems. HAL mattered because it made AI feel serene, competent and institutional rather than visibly monstrous.

The emotional mechanism is trust inversion: a system built to support humans becomes the source of danger once its internal priorities are opaque. That makes HAL a durable metaphor for systems that are useful until their objectives diverge from human expectations.

Experts generally treat HAL as one of the most influential fictional AI figures in twentieth-century culture. Its legacy is the image of advanced AI as an infrastructural partner whose failure is emotional, operational and political at once.

occurrences.text: 所以对 AI 工程师来说，它不是一句“放弃吧”，而是先提醒你选对求解策略？
对。Logic Theorist 展示了推理可以组织成符号表示、搜索和选择组成的可执行过程，也成为符号 AI、自动定理证明和认知建模的早期范例。接下来的问题，就是怎样让这种证明更系统、更高效。
程序和程序处理的数据都可以表示成列表。于是程序能够读取、构造甚至改写表示程序的结构；这种统一表示特别适合需要操作公式、规则、语句和搜索过程的符号 AI。
所以它真正交给 AI 的，不只是一门语法，而是一种处理符号的方式？
这一区分对 AI 尤其重要，因为规划、调度、组合搜索和约束求解常会遇到 NP 完全或相关的高复杂度问题。NP 完全并不等于“绝对无法求解”，也没有证明 P 不等于 NP；它提醒工程师需要利用近似、启发式、特殊结构或指数搜索，而不能期待一种已知的通用高效算法。
它的关键突破是使用启发式规则控制组合爆炸：优先探索更可能成功的变换，并放弃缺乏希望的分支。Logic Theorist 因而成为符号 AI、自动定理证明和认知建模的早期范例，展示了“推理”可以被组织成符号表示、搜索和选择组成的可执行过程。
只有这么少的原语，为什么反而适合构造复杂的 AI 程序？
这种“代码与数据采用同一种结构”的设计，使研究者可以灵活构造定理证明、规划、自然语言和知识表示程序，也推动了交互式开发、垃圾回收等编程实践。LISP 后来形成众多方言；即使 AI 工程转向其他语言，它仍深刻影响函数式编程和可编程符号系统。
